decision_rule: As in poles rounds 3-5 and ships A/B. Corrected: the value (or the plants.csv field that rests only on it) adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement or a company/brand-level fact as stated at the plant, ties a posting to the plant through a location shared by several sites, restates a dated plan or a posting date as something else (a completed conversion, a job start date, 'undated'), or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked with --check before calling a JSON-LD quote missing). A row too thin for the field and line that rest on it is corrected with the fuller value (ships precedent). Confirmed: the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning, or by that row's page; ends in a 'you' question; no pitch language; no Path deployment asserted at a Coperion site (mining rule 5). Scope (headline denominator, 147): every stated row of the 10 plants in the delegated fields (name, address, city, state, parent_company, products, weld_processes, materials, certifications, part_size_fit, production_type, existing_robots, welder_postings, triggers, headcount, relationship); every row of any tag of a claim cited by a score_* row (weld_processes, part_size_fit, production_type, welder_postings, triggers, headcount) including the four company multi_plant rows; and the 10 opening_line rows. Shared rows (c-schenck-process:path_customer and :path_customer_date, v-mining-heavy-equipment:demand_outlook) are under shared_claims_checked; stated prospect_test rows are under wider_set; neither is counted. lat/lon/county_fips/website/tier rows are out of scope.
error_rate_note: 17/147 = 11.6% (137 evidence rows + 10 opening lines). Over the 10% advisor threshold on the headline (ships precedent: field drift on an accurate row counts). Breakdown (sums to 17): (a) a wrong or misdescribed fact a rep could repeat, 8: 'undated' aggregator postings that carry JSON-LD datePosted x4 (8222, 8241, 8229, 10562); Workday posting startDate presented as a job start date x3 (8614, lines 10452, 10510); Whitewater's 2017 stainless plan restated as done and current x1 (8238). (b) a clause no page carries, in a row value or opening line, 4: Durand 8597 'screens and feeders', Tabor 8307 (brand listing tagged stated at the plant, with field clauses no page carries), Tabor line 10615 'feeder', Kansas City line 10572 'now part of Coperion'. (c) company-level product sentences tagged stated at the plant, 2: Whitewater 8239, McLanahan 8572.
